# @fyit/crouton-i18n

> Multi-language support with database-backed translations

## Components

- `CroutonI18nBlockTranslateTrigger`: Trigger button for translating block-editor fields
- `CroutonI18nInput`: Per-locale input for translatable fields
- `CroutonI18nLanguageSwitcher`: Select menu to switch the current language
- `CroutonI18nListCards`: Translation status badges for an entity
- `TranslationsUiList`: Searchable list of UI translations

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useT`
